identification: Bea Maddock (1934-2016), 'Resistance', limited edition relief print (woodcut/linocut look) in black, two dark hill forms either side of a white valley with house-like blocks and a hand-cut word along the slope, pencil-signed, titled and editioned in the lower margin (too small to read), 37 x 26 cm image, black frame with white mat.
